articles.title: Russia orders Apple to surrender users' messages on demand
articles.description: Apple and Microsoft have been added to a Russian state surveillance registry, requiring them to hand over users' text, video and audio messages without a legal process, and by request. Moscow at night (Credit: Evgenit/Pixabay) Multiple firms and apps are already on this same list, including WhatsApp and Telegram, so it's not clear why it has taken until now for Apple to be added. It's a continuation of the country's moves to control users' messages, though, as it follows Russia's blocking of FaceTime in 2025. According to Bloomberg, Apple and Microsoft were added to this registry of "organizers of information dissemination" on October 2, 2026. The registry is operated by the country's state media watchdog, Roskomnadzor, which previously forced Apple to remove VPN apps from the App Store. articles.title: What secrets does your moon sign hold about your inner world?
articles.description: In astrology your Moon sign is the sign that the Moon was passing through at the time of your birth. It is generally accepted that it offers a glimpse into your private self and how you react in situations where you feel vulnerable or seek comfort and is often associated with emotions, instincts, memories and emotional security. The Moon’s zodiac sign changes every two to three days, and this is why your birth time and place are essential for an accurate identification, unlike the Sun. The Moon sign is a good place to start to get insight into the hidden aspects of your inner world, personal needs and emotional patterns.
